hyperparameter_note: Per-dataset budget taken from the reference repository's scripts/Start.sh: SMD ratio 0.5 with 10 epochs, MSL/SMAP/PSM ratio 1 with 3 epochs, SWaT trained at ratio 0.5 but evaluated at ratio 0.1. The earlier iteration used the Time-Series-Library ratios and a fixed 10-epoch budget, which is kept under experiments/runs/mtsad_reproduction/at_tslib_budget_* as the sensitivity contrast.
source: ICLR 2022 Anomaly Transformer; attention and minimax terms transcribed from github.com/thuml/Anomaly-Transformer (model/attn.py, solver.py) and instantiated with the paper's per-dataset hyperparameters.
